name: nanquantile
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::nanquantile(Tensor self, Tensor q, int? dim=None, bool keepdim=False, *, str interpolation="linear") -> Tensor. Computes quantiles while ignoring NaNs without mutation or aliasing. Tests also cover scalar q, tensor/scalar out overloads, all interpolation modes, large tiled paths, all-NaN slices, noncontiguous output, special values, shapes, and errors.
